text: ok the new pieces came in, is it possible you can uh... apply it to all existing pieces in the data lol
resolution: Existing pieces placed ON the old fat 0.2 floor carried a baked +0.2x(floors-below) Y offset and floated 0.15x above the new thin floor (liftWallsOntoFloors only lifts, never lowers). Wrote cart/hmsc-int/tools/thinFloorMigrate.ts which appends one pieceMoved event per piece through the append-only world stream (fully undoable, no binary surgery) retargeting y_new = floor(y) + 0.05*k where k=floors-below (frac = 0.2*k). Backed up the data dir first, dry-ran, then applied to 603 pieces across 3 maps (main 464, untitled-3 101, untitled-12 38); idempotent re-run finds 0. Editor per-map gamefiles + /compiled boot key re-bake from the fixed snapshot on next Compile.
